items.title: Fred Lipsius interviewed by Monk Rowe. Boston, Massachusetts, July 25, 2018
items.q: Paul Shaffer. They were getting people.

ctx.x: Paul Shaffer. They were getting people. So the first group of people on the list in an email, and I’m thinking I’d like to play “Over the Rainbow” because I’ve played it and it really opens people’s hearts with my reharm and the way I play it. But I don’t want to show off and being the only guy that’s — you know I’m coming down and I’m just going to play by myself. They asked me to play with the band. And I have hearing loss so I didn’t want to play with anybody, loud music. I don’t care how good they play I just…
There was a big, fairly significant turnover after the first Blood, Sweat & Tears record. Did that come internally or was that partly from like Columbia Records.
